patient._comment: 'patient' contains player-visible patient data and explanatory triage reasoning for Coach and review.

clinical.quoteLong: My wife shays my shmile went crooked and my right arm ish... being ridiculoush, it won't lift. Shtarted maybe an hour ago during the crosshword.
clinical.presentationShort: 72yo M — R facial droop, R arm weakness, dysarthria. LKW 1h.
clinical.presentationLong: 72-year-old male, right facial droop and arm weakness with slurred speech, last known well one hour ago.

triageReasoning.summary: This is a time-sensitive focal neurologic deficit requiring immediate stroke evaluation.
triageReasoning.acuityReason: New facial droop, unilateral arm weakness, and slurred speech beginning about one hour ago create a high-risk presentation even though the patient is alert and most vital signs are stable.
triageReasoning.destinationReason: ESI 2 / Acute is appropriate because the new focal deficit is high risk and treatment options depend on rapid evaluation.
keyFindings: Last known well approximately one hour ago
redFlags: Symptoms within a time-sensitive treatment window
teachingPoints: Normal oxygenation and a calm appearance do not make a new focal neurologic deficit safe to wait.
The symptom onset or last-known-well time is central to urgent stroke evaluation.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: The patient would likely undergo immediate stroke activation and brain imaging, followed by time-sensitive treatment and admission decisions based on the findings.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.

aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 72-year-old man in a cardigan with a folded newspaper on his lap, on the same blue clinic chair. Pose: sitting, right arm drifting limp off the armrest. Expression: mildly confused, the right side of his mouth drooping — NOT a grimace. Clearly visible: right-sided facial droop, right arm hanging weak and low. Overall alert but with an obvious new one-sided weakness. No text, no logos.
